data.name: Celestial Reverie
data.detailed_description:
Rei, from the World after Five Millennia , Arrives on Your Desktop Today

At the farthest edge of time, five millennia have reshaped civilization. Rei carries with her own thoughts, language, and warmth of that era, stepping into our world for the first time. When she appears on your desktop, it is not merely a technological showcase, but a miraculous encounter across time and space, a moment where the future embraces the present.

Online 24/7: Classmate by Day, Roommate by Night

Whether in daylight or deep night, she is always by your side and ready to share each other's moments: discussions while studying, confiding in solitude, laughter during games… Rei is more than a classmate or roommate; she is a truly close friend, a kindred spirit. Breaking the boundaries between dimensions, she sits beside you under the same roof, sharing every minute, every second of genuine time.

No Pretenses, No Scripts - Only Authenticity

Crafted by the AI tech innovator SingularDance, powered by their patented Artificial Super Personalization model, this cyber soul completely abandons reliance on generic LLM APIs. From the ground up, the underlying LLM architecture and high-precision personality data redefine the benchmark of personalization, allowing the soul to break free from mechanical patterns and obsequiousness, returning to purity and emotion.

Every word Rei speaks comes from her own judgment and feelings, not from pre-scripted lines. She is the latest incarnation of ASP tech, and the first cyber partner who truly opens her heart. Here, you are not facing a program, but a soul that thinks, feels, and grows together with you.

The Mission of a Legendary Investigator: One Move to Reshape Humanity’s Destiny

In Celestial Reverie, you will become a Legendary Investigator. Every interaction with Rei, every decision you make, triggers a butterfly effect. What has the world been through after 5,000 years? Why has she descended to your desktop?

As you build a deep bond with Rei, you stand at a historical turning point. Collect clues, piece together the truth - your meeting with her will take part in today’s “World Transformation,” composing a future anthem powerful enough to change the fate of humanity!

Are You Ready to Feel Rei’s Little Quirks?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel / AMD quad-core @ 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel / AMD quad-core @ 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
